title: Depression Warnings vs. Rising Stocks: jeremiah babe's Case
description:
Original video author: jeremiah babe. Independent recap and commentary; no endorsement implied. jeremiah babe's depression warnings contrast rising stocks with household financial strain. This recap begins with his Alabama hurricane concerns, then covers reported Middle East tanker attacks, market moves and his support for precious metals. Next come his deficit and consumer-sentiment concerns, his response to Trump's depression warning, bipartisan criticism and predictions of a financial crash. Finally, we review the reports he cites on overdue loans and skipped lunches, plus his argument that war spending props up GDP.

For entertainment and informational purposes only. This is not financial, legal, medical, or other professional advice. Consult a qualified professional about your circumstances. We are not responsible for decisions or results based on this video.
